title: rcf doctor checks Playwright and a browser on browser-facing projects and skips them otherwise
asA: operator running rcf doctor on either a browser-facing or an API-only project
iWant: doctor to run playwright-present, browser-present, and playwright-mcp-reachable checks when at least one applied blueprint declares a browserSurface, and to skip all three with one printed reason line otherwise
soThat: browser-facing projects surface missing Playwright, missing browser, or an unreachable @playwright/mcp with actionable fix lines, while API-only projects are not asked to install a browser stack they will never use

acceptanceCriteria.description: packages/rcf-lite/package.json declares @playwright/mcp and playwright as optional peer dependencies (peerDependenciesMeta.<pkg>.optional: true). npm and pnpm do not fail install when the peers are absent.
acceptanceCriteria.then: .peerDependencies['@playwright/mcp'] and .peerDependencies.playwright are declared and .peerDependenciesMeta.<pkg>.optional is true for both

acceptanceCriteria.description: On a browser-facing fixture project (application-spa v1.4.0 applied), rcf doctor runs playwright-present, browser-present, and playwright-mcp-reachable; each check emits at most one fix line naming the exact remedy per the spec's fix-line table.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a browser-facing fixture with no @playwright/mcp installed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the three checks appear in the drift output and their fix lines match the spec's fix-line strings

acceptanceCriteria.description: On an API-only fixture project (application-api-rest applied, no browser-facing blueprint), rcf doctor prints one line naming the three skipped checks and their skip reason. The line is not suppressed by --quiet.
acceptanceCriteria.then: stdout contains exactly one line 'rcf doctor: skipping playwright-present, browser-present, playwright-mcp-reachable (no applied blueprint declares a browser surface).'

acceptanceCriteria.description: The three checks are legal values of --check <check>[,check]; passing one explicitly on a non-browser project overrides the skip and runs it.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the playwright-present check runs and reports its result rather than being skipped
